==Description==
'''Actor3''', called the '''Actor''' in-game, was the third and final actor enemy that appeared in the [[The Great Finale|third]] act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It was the strongest actor, having 2,000 health and 35% defense, though it was slower than the previous actors.

==Appearance==
'''Actor3''' was a black humanoid that wore a tuxedo suit. It also wore a black top hat, white and red bowtie and a white theatre mask. It held a black cane with its right arm and held its top hat in place with its left arm.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] are recommended.
**Multiple cheaper but weaker towers, like the [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Ace Pilot]] can also be effective against this.
**The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be very useful at boosting the firerate and range of your towers.
*As this enemy is not immune to anything, slowing towers like the [[Warden]] or [[Sledger]] can be very useful against this, giving your towers more time to kill it.
**If necessary, the [[Spotlight]]s can also be used to confuse the '''Actor3'''.
*Defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or the [[Electroshocker]] can be used to reduce its defense, though this is generally not needed if you have sufficient DPS towers.
